description: Kreuzungsskizzen Hamburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Inneres und Sport. Sketches of beamed intersections in Hamburg. Site plans of the light sign systems in Hamburg, including the port area, created with the Auto-CAD program are prepared as a data set for the specialist data server. The CAD data is simplified and split into feature classes and supplemented with object data. Coverage: Behörde für Inneres und Sport. The portal shows the English title as "Crossing sketches Hamburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Inneres und Sport. Its keywords include Maßstabsskizze, Straßenverkahr, opendata, Unfallskizzen, TRAN, Ohne gesetzliche Verpflichtung. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2018-01-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
